description: This file defines the EntityOne class, which implements an entity operation for the mini-language in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for executing entity lookups, gathering artifact info, and a factory class for creating instances.

classes.name: EntityOne
classes.description: Implements the <entity-one> element, performing entity lookup operations within the mini-language framework.

classes.name: EntityOneFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating EntityOne instances.

methods.name: EntityOne
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity operation, validating attributes and setting up the primary key finder.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the entity lookup using the delegator and primary key finder, handling exceptions and logging warnings.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information by adding the entity name to the artifact info context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the entity-one element with the entity name.
